passages.text: Then I saw a beast with ten horns and seven heads rising out of the sea. There were ten royal crowns on its horns and blasphemous names on its heads.
passages.sermon:
John saw a beast.
The beast rose out of the sea.
The beast had ten horns.
The beast had seven heads.
There were ten royal crowns on the horns.
There were blasphemous names on the heads.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἐκ τῆς θαλάσσης θηρίον ἀναβαῖνον ἔχον κέρατα δέκα καὶ κεφαλὰς ἑπτά καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν κεράτων αὐτοῦ δέκα διαδήματα καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτοῦ ὀνόματα βλασφημίας

passages.text: The beast I saw was like a leopard, with the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gave the beast his power and his throne and great authority.
passages.sermon:
John saw a beast.
The beast looked like a leopard.
The beast had feet like a bear.
The beast had a mouth like a lion.
The dragon gave the beast his power.
The dragon gave the beast his throne.
The dragon gave the beast great authority.
passages.original: καὶ τὸ θηρίον ὃ εἶδον ἦν ὅμοιον παρδάλει καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὡς ἄρκου καὶ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ ὡς στόμα λέοντος καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ δράκων τὴν δύναμιν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξουσίαν μεγάλην

passages.text: One of the heads of the beast appeared to be mortally wounded. But the mortal wound was healed, and the whole world marveled and followed the beast.
passages.sermon:
The beast had many heads.
One head looked as if someone had killed it.
This head had a deadly wound.
But the wound was healed.
Everyone on earth saw this.
All people were amazed.
They followed the beast.
passages.original: Καὶ μίαν ἐκ τῶν κεφαλῶν αὐτοῦ ὡς ἐσφαγμένην εἰς θάνατον καὶ ἡ πληγὴ τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ ἐθεραπεύθη καὶ ἐθαυμάσθη ὅλη ἡ γῆ ὀπίσω τοῦ θηρίου

passages.text: They worshiped the dragon who had given authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast, and who can wage war against it?”
passages.sermon:
People worshiped the dragon.
The dragon gave authority to the beast.
People also worshiped the beast.
They said, “Who is like the beast?”
They said, “Who can fight against the beast?”
passages.original: καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ δράκοντι ὅτι ἔδωκεν τὴν ἐξουσίαν τῷ θηρίῳ καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ θηρίῳ λέγοντες Τίς ὅμοιος τῷ θηρίῳ καὶ τίς δύναται πολεμῆσαι μετ’ αὐτοῦ

passages.text: The beast was given a mouth to speak arrogant and blasphemous words, and authority to act for 42 months.
passages.sermon:
The beast received a mouth.
The beast spoke proud words.
The beast spoke blasphemies.
The beast received authority.
The beast acted for forty-two months.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ στόμα λαλοῦν μεγάλα καὶ βλασφημίας καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ ἐξουσία ποιῆσαι μῆνας τεσσεράκοντα καὶ δύο

passages.text: And the beast opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against God and to slander His name and His tabernacle—those who dwell in heaven.
passages.sermon:
The beast opened its mouth.
The beast spoke blasphemies against God.
The beast slandered God's name.
The beast slandered God's tabernacle.
The beast slandered those who dwell in heaven.
passages.original: καὶ ἤνοιξεν τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ εἰς βλασφημίας πρὸς τὸν Θεόν βλασφημῆσαι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ τοὺς ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ σκηνοῦντας

passages.text: Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
passages.sermon:
The beast received permission to fight against the saints.
The beast received power to defeat the saints.
The beast received authority over every tribe.
The beast received authority over every people.
The beast received authority over every language group.
The beast received authority over every nation.
passages.original: Καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ ποιῆσαι πόλεμον μετὰ τῶν ἁγίων καὶ νικῆσαι αὐτούς καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ ἐξουσία ἐπὶ πᾶσαν φυλὴν καὶ λαὸν καὶ γλῶσσαν καὶ ἔθνος

passages.text: And all who dwell on the earth will worship the beast—all whose names have not been written from the foundation of the world in the Book of Life belonging to the Lamb who was slain.
passages.sermon:
All people living on the earth will worship the beast.
These people do not have their names written in the Book of Life.
The Book of Life belongs to the Lamb.
The Lamb was slain.
God wrote the names in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world.
passages.original: καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὗ οὐ γέγραπται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τῆς ζωῆς τοῦ Ἀρνίου τοῦ ἐσφαγμένου ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου

passages.text: He who has an ear, let him hear: “If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he will go; if anyone is to die by the sword, by the sword he must be killed.” Here is a call for the perseverance and faith of the saints.
passages.sermon:
Anyone who can hear should listen.
If someone is destined for captivity, he will go into captivity.
If someone is to be killed by the sword, he must be killed by the sword.
This is a call for the perseverance of the saints.
This is a call for the faith of the saints.
passages.original: Εἴ τις ἔχει οὖς ἀκουσάτω Εἴ τις εἰς αἰχμαλωσίαν εἰς αἰχμαλωσίαν ὑπάγει εἴ τις ἐν μαχαίρῃ ἀποκτανθῆναι δεῖ αὐτὸν ἐν μαχαίρῃ ἀποκτανθῆναι Ὧδέ ἐστιν ἡ ὑπομονὴ καὶ ἡ πίστις τῶν ἁγίων

passages.text: Then I saw another beast rising out of the earth. This beast had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
passages.sermon:
I saw another beast.
This beast came up from the earth.
This beast had two horns.
The horns looked like a lamb’s horns.
This beast spoke like a dragon.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἄλλο θηρίον ἀναβαῖνον ἐκ τῆς γῆς καὶ εἶχεν κέρατα δύο ὅμοια ἀρνίῳ καὶ ἐλάλει ὡς δράκων

passages.text: And this beast exercised all the authority of the first beast and caused the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose mortal wound had been healed.
passages.sermon:
The second beast appeared on the earth.
The second beast acted with all the authority of the first beast.
The second beast used this authority in the presence of the first beast.
The second beast made the people of the earth worship the first beast.
The first beast had received a deadly wound.
The deadly wound of the first beast was healed.
passages.original: καὶ τὴν ἐξουσίαν τοῦ πρώτου θηρίου πᾶσαν ποιεῖ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιεῖ τὴν γῆν καὶ τοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ κατοικοῦντας ἵνα προσκυνήσουσιν τὸ θηρίον τὸ πρῶτον οὗ ἐθεραπεύθη ἡ πληγὴ τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ

passages.text: And the second beast performed great signs to cause even fire from heaven to come down to earth in the presence of the people.
passages.sermon:
The second beast appeared on the earth.
This beast had power.
The second beast performed great signs.
The second beast made fire come down from heaven.
The fire came down to earth.
People saw these things happen.
passages.original: Καὶ ποιεῖ σημεῖα μεγάλα ἵνα καὶ πῦρ ποιῇ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβαίνειν εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀνθρώπων

passages.text: Because of the signs it was given to perform on behalf of the first beast, it deceived those who dwell on the earth, telling them to make an image to the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet had lived.
passages.sermon:
The second beast received power to perform signs.
The second beast performed these signs in the presence of the first beast.
The second beast used these signs to deceive all who live on the earth.
The second beast told the people of the earth to make an image of the first beast.
The first beast had been wounded by the sword.
The first beast had survived the wound.
passages.original: καὶ πλανᾷ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς διὰ τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ ποιῆσαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θηρίου λέγων τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ποιῆσαι εἰκόνα τῷ θηρίῳ ὃς ἔχει τὴν πληγὴν τῆς μαχαίρης καὶ ἔζησεν

passages.text: The second beast was permitted to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that the image could speak and cause all who refused to worship it to be killed.
passages.sermon:
The second beast had great power.
The second beast received permission to act.
The second beast gave breath to the image of the first beast.
The image of the first beast became able to speak.
The image of the first beast acted with authority.
The image caused all who refused to worship it to be killed.
passages.original: καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ δοῦναι πνεῦμα τῇ εἰκόνι τοῦ θηρίου ἵνα καὶ λαλήσῃ ἡ εἰκὼν τοῦ θηρίου καὶ ποιήσῃ ἵνα ὅσοι ἐὰν μὴ προσκυνήσωσιν τῇ εἰκόνι τοῦ θηρίου ἀποκτανθῶσιν

passages.text: And the second beast required all people small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead, so that no one could buy or sell unless he had the mark—the name of the beast or the number of its name.
passages.sermon:
The second beast acted with authority.
The second beast required every person to obey.
He required the small and the great.
He required the rich and the poor.
He required the free and the slave.
He told them to receive a mark.
They must receive the mark on their right hand.
Or they must receive the mark on their forehead.
No one could buy anything without the mark.
No one could sell anything without the mark.
Only the person with the mark could buy or sell.
The mark is the name of the beast.
Or the mark is the number of the beast’s name.
passages.original: Καὶ ποιεῖ πάντας τοὺς μικροὺς καὶ τοὺς μεγάλους καὶ τοὺς πλουσίους καὶ τοὺς πτωχούς καὶ τοὺς ἐλευθέρους καὶ τοὺς δούλους ἵνα δῶσιν αὐτοῖς χάραγμα ἐπὶ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν τῆς δεξιᾶς ἢ ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον αὐτῶν καὶ ἵνα μή τις δύνηται ἀγοράσαι ἢ πωλῆσαι εἰ μὴ ὁ ἔχων τὸ χάραγμα τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θηρίου ἢ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ

passages.text: Here is a call for wisdom: Let the one who has insight calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, and that number is 666.
passages.sermon:
This is a call for wisdom.
Anyone who has understanding should calculate the number of the beast.
The number belongs to a man.
The number is 666.
passages.original: Ὧδε ἡ σοφία ἐστίν ὁ ἔχων νοῦν ψηφισάτω τὸν ἀριθμὸν τοῦ θηρίου ἀριθμὸς γὰρ ἀνθρώπου ἐστίν καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτοῦ ἑξακόσιοι ἑξήκοντα ἕξ
